decisive_items: pain and swelling in both knees
response.rationale: Methotrexate exposure followed by acute bilateral knee synovitis with elevated inflammatory markers and no fever best fits methotrexate-induced arthritis; reactive arthritis lacks a clear infectious trigger and septic arthritis is unlikely without fever.

rejected.why: Chronic symmetric polyarthritis pattern not acute post-methotrexate; lacks typical morning stiffness and serology.
Afebrile and bilateral symmetric involvement make septic arthritis improbable.
No preceding genitourinary or gastrointestinal infection to trigger reactive arthritis.
Ectopic pregnancy itself does not explain acute arthritis; no direct link.
Describes the ectopic pregnancy but not the new joint symptoms.
